status: First color-only proposals, awaiting Workspace render and owner review; not calibrated film emulations
base: Exact E-PL9 build 1101 COLOR template; CMIO Natural slots for desktop trials

recipes.name: gold200-draft-v0
recipes.target: Explore warmer chromatic colors, modest warm-sector saturation and restrained blue/green colors while retaining skin and edges. Neutral warmth and tone are later controls, not implemented here.

recipes.name: portra400-draft-v0
recipes.target: Explore softer chromatic colors and lighter color sectors, reducing warm-sector intensity more than Gold. A softer luminance curve and highlight handling remain later work.
